Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand your infant is experiencing bilious vomiting, an inability to pass meconium, and abdominal distension. To help me evaluate the severity and potential causes, have the baby had any bowel movements at all since birth?

REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Dilated loops of bowel with no gas in the rectum, suggestive of a distal obstruction.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intestinal Malrotation with Volvulus.

The combination of bilious vomiting, failure to pass meconium, abdominal distension, and an X-ray showing dilated bowel loops with an empty rectum is highly indicative of a distal obstruction. Given the infant's age and symptoms, intestinal malrotation with volvulus is the most critical diagnosis to consider immediately.
